chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil narrated to me from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Saif ibn Amirah from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "Sitting with the people of religion is the honor of the world and the hereafter."
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of sitting with religious people according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith underscores the concept of *mu'asharah* (social companionship) as a means of spiritual elevation, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the social dimension of faith. It highlights that associating with the *Ahl al-Din* not only refines one's character but also secures honor (*sharaf*) in both the temporal and eternal realms, serving as a practical guide for community building.
